assay: bulk total-RNA RNA-seq (rRNA-depleted, NextSeq500 2x36) of human iPSC-derived (414C2 iMuSC) myotubes, day 4 after adenoviral infection (S2.10.p1)
samples: 12 cultures: pAV-mCherry (control), pAV-MAFA, pAV-MAFB, pAV-MAF, n=3 each (FIG4 C-H)
primary_estimand: Effect of adenoviral overexpression of each large MAF transcription factor (MAFA, MAFB, MAF) versus mCherry control on the myotube transcriptome; not an exercise estimand
paper_method: CLC Main Workbench Empirical Analysis of DGE (edgeR exact test), genes with zero counts in any sample excluded (S2.10.p1)
exercise_component: Exercise/training appears only in the human biopsy analyses (GSE200398 Russian endurance- vs power-trained, resting-state, cross-sectional; dbGaP phs001048 Finnish), which are separate accessions (S2.18.p1, S3.4.p3, DA.p1). GSE283853 contains no exercise, training, or physical-activity factor.
